vignette: A 30-year-old woman has an unsteady gait with a wide base and cannot tandem walk, but the finger-nose and heel-shin tests are almost normal when she is lying down. She has headaches in the morning and vomits. Her discs are swollen.
stem: Which part of the cerebellum is most likely involved?
explanation: Severe truncal and gait ataxia with relatively spared limb coordination is a midline (vermian) syndrome; a midline mass over the fourth ventricle also obstructs CSF flow, explaining the headache, vomiting and papilledema.
